payload.reason: The lower performance on Vikidia-FR compared to Newsela-ES is attributed to the diversity of content in Vikidia-FR and the ranking metrics that penalize incorrect rankings more severely due to fewer reading levels.

claims.text: Vikidia-FR has more diverse content compared to Newsela-ES, which has content from the same domain as Newsela-EN.
Ranking metrics penalize Vikidia-FR more heavily because it has only two reading levels, leading to a greater impact from incorrect rankings.
Incorrect rankings in Vikidia-FR can result in a completely reversed list, heavily affecting SRC and KTCC scores.
